name: TrayTasks

images.alt: TrayTasks task list open from the Windows system tray
TrayTasks daily view with task deadlines and completion controls
TrayTasks calendar showing scheduled tasks

shortDescription: A lightweight Windows task manager that keeps tasks and reminders close at hand in the system tray.
description: TrayTasks is a Windows desktop app for organizing tasks and reminders from the system tray. Create tasks with dates, times, importance, recurring schedules, and project groups. Use the calendar, configurable advance notifications, snooze, search, and filters to stay on top of what’s next. Your data is stored locally, with backup and restore options.

name: Todo App

images.alt: Todo App form for adding a new task
Todo App screen for editing an existing task
Todo App task list with a task deletion action
Todo App task summary displayed in an Android home screen widget

shortDescription: An Android task manager for organizing daily tasks and recurring reminders, with a handy home screen widget.
description: Todo App is an Android task manager for creating, editing, and organizing tasks. Set one-time or recurring reminders, receive notifications with vibration, and keep track of what is due today, upcoming, or still pending. Tasks are stored locally on the device, and the home screen widget shows task counts and provides a shortcut to add a task.

shortDescription: A mobile app for freestyle rappers to practice improvisation with random words, themes, and rhyme endings.
description: Freestylea helps freestyle rap lovers practice creativity, flow, and improvisation anywhere. Choose a practice mode: get random words that refresh on a timer, explore themes, or receive rhyme endings to spark your next bars. Built as a native Android app with a simple, focused interface.

name: Simon Says Classic

images.alt: Simon Says Classic start screen with four colored sequence buttons

shortDescription: An Android memory game where you repeat an increasingly long sequence of colored lights.
description: Simon Says Classic is an Android take on the classic memory game. Watch the colored buttons light up, then repeat the sequence. Each successful round adds another color. The app tracks your current score and saves your personal record locally.
